description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Due Date Respective Loan Repayment Schedule functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It defines multiple test scenarios to verify the behavior of loan schedules, charges, and repayments under various configurations and conditions.

classes.name: DueDateRespectiveLoanRepaymentScheduleTest
classes.description: An integration test class that verifies different scenarios of the due date based repayment schedule in loans, including various configurations of charges, repayments, and strategies.

classes.name: DueDateRespectiveLoanRepaymentScheduleTest
classes.description: An integration test class verifying various scenarios related to due date based repayment schedules, including adjustments, refunds, charge modifications, schedule rescheduling, and handling complex loan lifecycle events.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes common test setup before each test, including REST Assured configuration and helper instances.

methods.name: scenario1
methods.description: Tests a loan with penalty fee interest principal in advance strategy, verifying repayment schedule and transaction details across multiple partial repayments and charges.

methods.name: scenario2
methods.description: Validates behavior with charges and partial repayments, including paying only principal portions and handling multiple charges.

methods.name: scenario3
methods.description: Tests full repayment after partial repayments, ensuring the loan is closed with no outstanding balances, considering in advance principal portions.

methods.name: scenario4
methods.description: Simulates a disbursement with multiple installments, partial payments, and charges, verifying schedule adjustments and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: scenario5
methods.description: Tests overpayment and partial payments with multiple charges, ensuring the schedule correctly reflects overpaid status and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: scenario6
methods.description: Verifies the handling of snooze fees and partial repayments, especially focusing on fee and principal portions.

methods.name: scenario7
methods.description: Tests loan disbursement, full and partial repayments, reversals, and fees addition, mainly focusing on fee charges and overpayment handling.

methods.name: scenario8
methods.description: Tests disbursement, snooze fee, partial and full repayments, reversals, multiple charges, and schedule adjustments for the respective loan scenario involving penalty interest and fees in advance strategy.

methods.name: scenario9
methods.description: Extends scenario8 with additional reversals, fee charges, and multiple partial repayments and schedule adjustments, testing complex reversal and correction flows.

methods.name: scenario10
methods.description: Simulates loan disbursement, schedule rescheduling, partial refunds, charge adjustments, and subsequent repayments to verify schedule and overdue handling in a complex business date setup.

methods.name: finally
methods.description: Resets global configuration to disable business date after each test scenario to ensure environment consistency.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, configuring REST Assured and helper instances.

methods.name: scenario11
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive test involving loan disbursement, snooze fee, partial refunds, charge adjustment, and post-refund assertions to validate schedule accuracy amidst complex business date manipulations.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to apply for a loan application with specified parameters and return the loan ID.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithNoAccountingNoInterest
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product without accounting and interest, used in test setups.
